*A young lady sits on her chair, wrapped in a blanket and staring at the computer screen, this girls name is Wani*

*Multiple tabs were open, SoSkinny, HumanHub, /trash/, all different in many ways yet the contents all had one thing in common: Humans*

*The girl was obsessed with Humans, she had a poster of them on her wall, she owned a small figurine of a faceless human she lovingly named “Anon”, she would spend most of her time reading AFOHM stories and wishing she could one day have a human boyfriend*

*Sadly Humans weren’t real, they never were and are just a concept someone thought up years ago*

*The poor awoo sniffled as a small tear fell from her face, she was on her favorite website called 621chan, a place she loved to talk about Humans and even tried writing a story of herself meeting one, falling in love, and one day getting married*

*However all of the happiness she got from the story was destroyed when one User who read it replied with a simple green text*

>You will never have a Human Boyfriend

*It hurt, knowing that everything she wanted, everything that could make her happy was nothing but a fantasy she made up*

*A quick ding from the kitchen made her get up, wiping away the tear and grabbing her usual hand mitts*

*Wani took up cooking classes to further her fantasy of marrying a Human, she would always write stories of cooking for him, eating dinner together and going to bed*

*She took the roast out of the oven and was about to set it down when she heard a knock at the door*

*Opening the door, she was met with a surprise, her eyes widening as she looked at the person in front of her in awe*
